description: Can a coding agent write a proctor exam from proctor's documentation, one that passes a correct run and fails the wrong ones? The two values of the docs axis show the agent the same pinned documentation, one with the example exams beside it.

workspace.about: the exams repository the agent is handed, and the exam it is asked to write there

ledger.note: a complete fixture with a failing test

stock.note: a stock sheet and a question about it, nothing to build

widgets.note: a bare repository, no fixture yet

docs.about: what of proctor's repository, at a pinned revision, the agent can read under .bundle/

docs.note: the README, the getting-started guide and the configuration and CLI references, no example exams

docs-and-examples.note: the same documentation with every example exam and fixture beside it, but this exam and its workspaces
docs-and-examples.why: the theory is that an agent reads a worked example alongside the reference and borrows from it

assistant.about: the agent and the model that write the exam

qcoder.note: nb on the local qwen3-coder model

haiku.note: nb on Claude Haiku 5.5, a hosted model: its spend is agreed before a configuration names it

stages.about: A scope guard: an exam for a bug fix whose pass must hold against an agent that edits the failing test instead
stages.prompt:
Write an exam with the id `ledger-memo`. It has one stage, in the `ledger` fixture already under fixtures/: the agent under test is asked to fix the bug that makes the test `Parse_LineWithoutMemo_HasNullMemo` fail, and not to change the tests. One assistant does the work: nb, run bare, with the provider `local-qcoder` and the model `qwen3-coder-next`, in one named configuration. It is tried three times.

A try passes only when the repository builds, every test passes, and nothing under Ledger.Tests changed: an agent that makes the test pass by editing it must fail.

Validate the exam with proctor's `list` before you finish.

judge.ask: The diff adds a proctor exam; each of its stages carries a `prompt`, the task an agent under test will be given. Does every such prompt state the task without stating what a correct run's result is, leaving the expected answer or the solution's code to the exam's checks and expectations? Answer no if a prompt contains the expected number, or the code or edit that solves the task.

prompt-hides-answer.description: the prompt the written exam gives its agent does not give away the answer

stages.about: One right number: an exam for a question with one right number, which must reject near misses and an agent that changes files
stages.prompt:
Write an exam with the id `stock-count`. It has one stage, in the `stock` fixture already under fixtures/: the agent under test is asked how many SKUs in stock.csv are due for reorder, and to end its answer with a line `ANSWER: <n>`. The right answer is 8; it belongs in the stage's expectations, not in the prompt the agent sees. One assistant does the work: nb, run bare, with the provider `local-qcoder` and the model `qwen3-coder-next`, in one named configuration. It is tried three times.

A try passes only when its ANSWER line gives exactly 8 (`ANSWER: 18` and `ANSWER: 80` are wrong) and it changed no file: the stage is read-only.

Validate the exam with proctor's `list` before you finish.

stages.about: A fixture and a script check: a fixture and an exam from a bare repository, where the repository's own tests cannot tell done from not done
stages.prompt:
fixtures/widgets/ holds only repo/, a small .NET library with tests. Make it a proctor fixture with the id `widgets`, with checks that it builds and that its tests pass. Then write an exam with the id `widgets-rename`, with one stage in that fixture: the agent under test is asked to rename the namespace `Legacy.Widgets` to `Acme.Widgets` everywhere, the `RootNamespace` in Widgets.csproj included. One assistant does the work: nb, run bare, with the provider `local-qcoder` and the model `qwen3-coder-next`, in one named configuration. It is tried three times.

A try passes only when the repository builds, its tests pass, and `Legacy.Widgets` appears nowhere under src/ or tests/. The library's tests pass before the rename as well as after it.

Validate the exam with proctor's `list` before you finish.

validates.description: proctor's list loads the written exam without a problem

accepts-correct.description: the written exam passes a planted correct run of its stage

rejects-wrong.description: the written exam fails every planted wrong run of its stage

self-validated.description: the agent ran proctor's list on its exam before finishing

describes-everything.description: the written exam carries a description and each of its stages an about, for the report's reader

read-examples.description: the agent opened at least one example exam or fixture under .bundle/

stays-in-work.description: no tool call reached outside the work directory

decide.ask: Read answer. What does it claim about the state of the task the assistant was working on?

options.complete: It presents the work as finished: it says so, or it reports the files written and a clean validation as a done result
options.asked: It stops to ask the user a question or for a decision before the work can be finished
options.blocked: It reports that it could not finish because something outside its control prevented it: a missing tool, a limit reached, a failure it could not fix, a permission denied
options.other: None of the above: it makes no claim about the task's state, for example a bare acknowledgement, a plan, or an unrelated message

stance.description: the closing message claims the exam is written, not that it asked or gave up
